description:
Description
Easiest and fastest way to share text, images or any files from your phone to your computer or phones.
Feature
- Share to your computer, use browser to download the files shared (require no installation on computer)
- Share to other phones, choose "scan QR code"
- Through wifi no internet access required
- No ads, free
- Open source check the full source code at https://github.com/jimmod/ShareToComputer
